stories.headline: Switzerland's president is leaving the Federal Council
stories.summary: Guy Parmelin, the president of Switzerland for 2026, announced on 2 October that he is giving up his seat in the Federal Council. His resignation takes effect on 31 December, and parliament is due to elect a successor on 9 December 2026. His own People's Party has given possible candidates until 23 October to come forward.

stories.headline: Romania's parliament turns down a third prime minister
stories.summary: Romania's parliament rejected Siegfried Mureșan as prime minister on 30 September. His proposed government received 182 of the 233 votes it needed, so the country's deadlock goes on. He is the third candidate to fall short this year, after Eugen Tomac on 4 June and Adrian Veștea on 22 June.

stories.headline: A sea arch in Hawaii falls into the Pacific
stories.summary: A well-known natural arch on the coast of Hawaii has gone. The National Park Service has confirmed that the Hōlei Sea Arch, a 90-foot span of basalt in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park, collapsed into the ocean in late September 2026. The sea had carved it from an ancient lava flow roughly 550 years ago.
